why: The shipped behaviour issue #367 reverses, restored exactly: countdown ticks bank toward the profile's reaction delay, so an enemy that watched the player through the announced fire-free phase fires on the first live tick. Measured over the golden trace's population under this mutation: in 12 of the 30 traced runs an enemy stood at or past its full authored span the moment the countdown ended. Not a subtle regression to leave to a reviewer's eye -- it is the difference between a telegraphed first shot and an instant one, and the player has no counterplay to the second.
